notes.title: Captain Pawsome sails into Early Access!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793228/397c07d8e65e5027dc621dff084f7c4a049de5d0.jpg

Hello, cat captains!

Today, we set sail to the high seas as Captain Pawsome launches in Early Access! Put on your captain’s hat and shoes, grab your fishing gear, take your place behind the ship’s helm and let the adventure begin!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793228/a56046a01e97cff96c8571bc0c6c2786d5ffb9c9.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793228/2a71fbe6a5c5000b1f9ee0afb6374e801a408a81.jpg

In Captain Pawsome, your journey will take you to many places and while you follow the story of cleaning up the seas and defeating the monster ravaging the seas, you’ll have your fill of other exciting things to do! You’ll customize both your boat and house, upgrade your skills and fishing equipment, run your own shop and so much more! 

Please read below to learn more about the details about all of the exciting adventures and activities that await you in the Early Access of Captain Pawsome!

The story is here!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793228/1be66773e016d8d70cac9a8d4b0f84fc84d72f78.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793228/8d04794b0862db6d666d3d5047fa1832c1d6d7a8.jpg

The first iteration of the storyline has been added! Embark on a purr-fectly exciting odyssey as you step into the paws of a new and ambitious feline captain! Your mission: help Commander Tuna-Breath to transform a dilapidated ship into a sleek seafaring marvel. Dive into the treacherous waters, battling not only the detritus that plagues the sea but also hunting down the rarest and most exotic fish species. But beware – a monstrous menace looms, leaving destruction in its wake. Are you ready to navigate the high seas, conquer challenges, and triumph over the colossal foe that threatens to turn this aquatic haven into chaos? 

Upgrade your ship and fishing equipment!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793228/cea16babb6ed656c76659e3cce2e2ac4e9ad677c.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793228/6c74f4339c48fc70561b7d408ab78569ca9083fe.jpg

On your quest, you won’t just tidy up the mess, but also dive into a thrilling treasure hunt beneath the waves! As you sweep away the debris and haul in a mesmerizing array of fish, you'll be harvesting not only aquatic wonders, but the essential materials required to forge a ship that's the envy of the seas. It's not just about cleaning – it's a journey of discovery, where every discarded item and every unique catch adds a spark to your arsenal. Get ready to reel in both excitement and resources, all in the pursuit of crafting the ultimate vessel and mastering the art of angling!

Run your own business!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793228/20e93cf65d313742b8e644dfdae49a588c2871cc.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793228/da4bbd834f5af5edbd0ade0925f03a75f6486839.jpg

Transform your ship into a shop, where your entrepreneurial spirit sets sail! You'll not only reel in treasures and exotic catches but also curate your own shop right on deck. Engage with the local residents, enticing them with the wonders of the deep sea, and watch as they exchange their currency for your maritime treasures. The gleaming coins you amass won't just jingle in your pockets – they'll pave the way for skill upgrades that turn you from a novice to a nautical maestro. Unleash the power of commerce as you navigate the waves, turning your ship into a thriving hub of trade and skill advancement!

Own and decorate your humble abode!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793228/2f26c9bfa4e2a8a3efd3dfb02c3d23ab23ab4a48.jpg

The deck of your ship is not just a workspace, but also a home awaiting your creative touch! Your vessel harbors a unique apartment brimming with potential. Dive into the depths and haul in furniture treasures from the sea, transforming your living quarters into a captivating reflection of your adventures. Embark on a journey of interior design as you renovate, upgrade, and decorate your shipboard abode with treasures salvaged from the ocean depths and turn your apartment into a maritime masterpiece. 

Customize your furry captain!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793228/09ba2a21e1b189fc4ef9f2de39c442ab4a021ace.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793228/fa3d52785c32a23fd988820916e569a2101b0e07.jpg

Unleash your inner fashionista on the high seas with a wardrobe that's as adventurous as your nautical escapades! Dive into the style treasure trove as you fish out chic ensembles, "borrow" some feline fashion flair from fellow island residents, and even snag the latest trends from cat parcels that mysteriously drop in as whimsical deliveries. Get ready to make a splash not only with your maritime exploits but also with a wardrobe that's as bold and dynamic as the ocean itself!

Venture forth into the deep seas!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793228/cdfc76a71b2a4424df90305efa566975a1138557.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793228/e1af0cef63d493ea22e133fa1224988fd8574f8a.jpg

As you cast your line, be prepared to delve into breathtaking and mysterious biomes that unveil the beauty hidden beneath the waves. Explore the mesmerizing depths where exotic species of fish lurk, each one a captivating discovery waiting to be made. Get ready to face mysteries as you unveil the secrets of these deep-sea realms, making every fishing excursion a voyage into the unknown!

This is what awaits you in the Early Access of Captain Pawsome! Prepare for a whisker-tingling adventure like no other and be ready for updates and additions as we move forward towards the full release! We’ll be updating you on a regular basis, but if you have any questions - feel free to ask in the discussion forums. 

Have fun fairing the feline-filled seas!

notes.title: 🐾🐾🐾 Captain Pawesome - Next Fest DEV LIVE-STREAM
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793228/3d9b30ed2ea13b73d0cb7688dbea27dca012226b.gif

Captain Pawsome is a cozy 2D fishing game where you play as the cat. Manage your own shop and upgrade your ship as you journey across the ocean, cleaning up the environment and catching tens of unique types of fish. Customize your cat, craft items, upgrade your gear, sail in style, and embark on a delightful adventure filled with charm. Will you rise to the occasion and leave your mark on the high seas? Captain Pawsome awaits your command!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793228/e21a4e6ef800d84e64362841b9dd3a7a400e7887.gif

Features:

  Step into the paws of an adorable cat captain
  Embark on an adventure to explore vast open seas aboard your ship
  Take on the mission of cleaning up the ocean, which is plagued by trash and debris
  Upgrade your ship by collecting various resources from the open waters
  Manage your shop, gather valuable fish and items on your journeys to sell them with profit
  Catch a diverse range of fish species
  Meet diverse characters encountered during your maritime adventures
  Customize the appearance of your cat captain with choices of different cat breeds, fur patterns, and colors
  Dress your captain in a range of stylish outfits, each with its unique look
  Embark on a charming adventure filled with wonder and responsibilities as you make your mark on the high seas
  Immerse yourself in a captivating world full of charm


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793228/b402f267421d6fc739bf2260322e848f7248d61e.gif

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1551000/Captain_Pawsome/

notes.title: Set sail with CAPTAIN PAWSOME!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793228/3d9b30ed2ea13b73d0cb7688dbea27dca012226b.gif

Hello PAWesome people! 
Today, we embark on a fantastic adventure as Captain Pawsome sets sail on the open waters. We are thrilled to invite you to test the game demo as part of the Steam NEXT Festival!

[previewyoutube=MZUqCK0f-Zc;full][/previewyoutube]
🎣 Captain Pawsome invites you to dive into the heartwarming 2D fishing experience of a lifetime! Picture yourself as the fearless feline captain of your own destiny as you embark on an extraordinary odyssey across the vast ocean. Cleanse the seas of debris, and reel in a treasure trove of one-of-a-kind fish species. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793228/916221cb7331d0ecf4e9e7d76b70c6db9aada304.png

🚢Embark on your journey in a ship that's not just a vessel, but a reflection of your individuality. Upgrade your ship by collecting various resources from the open waters. Manage your shop, gather valuable items, and sell them with profit.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793228/315507b93914610abd167a984ac73865e50be9ab.png

⚓️ But that's not all! In Captain Pawsome, you have the power to become the ultimate master of your adventure. Customize your cat captain with PAWsitively adorable outfits, craft useful items to aid your voyage, and upgrade your fishing gear to legendary proportions. Sail with style!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793228/4d08208e30c662ff8036006f825b5712e5fbc5bc.png

🌟 Captain Pawsome eagerly awaits your command! Don't miss your chance to experience the magic of this captivating demo as part of the Steam NEXT Festival. It's time to embark on an adventure that will have you hooked from the very first cast! Are you ready to make a splash? Play the demo now! 🐟🐱⚓️



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793228/78e8993306a20838849ba423dc40c12e8f469dbf.png

WISHLIST NOW!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1551000/Captain_Pawsome/
